solver: simpleFoam, steady RANS, kOmegaSST, wall functions
convergence: drag-based: std over the averaging window < 1% of Cd and drift between its halves < 0.5% (pressure residual stalls near 0.3)
axes: Y up, Z length (nose toward +Z), X width
normals: outward from the car into the fluid
tau_convention: force per area exerted by the fluid on the car
averaging: fieldAverage over the last 500 of 1500 iterations
